name: Seamband
description: A third ink laid in a narrow band right on the seam, so the join is drawn rather than implied.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 54%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 46%; left: 0; right: 0; height: 8%; background: var(--color2); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
